note: Nothing on this list has been implemented. Each item needs your choice (option A/B/C or 'defer') before work starts. 'Benefit' and 'Cost' are the author's assessment, not verified facts.

rows.suggestion: Build a multi-season injury history from the official NFL weekly injury report (weeks and seasons on the nfl.com selector).
rows.benefit: Needed for any backtest of injury-based signals.
rows.cost: Moderate - many pages; manual collection through the fetch tool is slow.
options: A: Collect 2026 weeks 1-10 first, then decide

rows.suggestion: Ingest official weekly depth charts from nfl.com team pages so that every injury is mapped to its starter and the backup who replaces him.
rows.benefit: Directly answers the 2nd/3rd/4th-string question for both offence and defence.
rows.cost: Moderate - depth-chart page not yet located.
options: B: Use headline-level evidence only (current state)

rows.suggestion: Evaluate licensed sportsbook-odds data vendors (opening and closing lines, props) with written licence terms.
rows.benefit: Enables closing-line value (CLV) and real validation.
rows.cost: Likely paid; licence terms must be reviewed.
options: A: Evaluate vendors and report cost
B: Use public data only (see SG-04)
rows.source: None (vendor data is not verified in this session)

rows.suggestion: Check public odds and score datasets for licence terms and coverage before use.
rows.cost: Licence and quality checks required; may be incomplete.

rows.suggestion: Freeze the validation rules (gates G0-G8 on the Strategies page) before testing, and choose the primary metric (CLV, ROI, or Brier score).
rows.benefit: Prevents choosing rules after seeing results (a common source of false positives).
options: A: Primary metric = CLV; ROI secondary
B: Primary metric = Brier score / calibration; ROI secondary

rows.suggestion: Check nfl.com terms of use before any automated collection of its pages.
options: A: Check terms, then decide on automation

rows.suggestion: Add a GitHub Actions workflow to rebuild the site and run the link and source checker on every push.
rows.benefit: Keeps links and sources checked automatically.
options: B: Add workflow with scheduled data refresh

rows.suggestion: Make tables sortable and searchable by team, player, status and unit on each page.
rows.benefit: Faster review of the injury data.

rows.suggestion: Decide the scope: research only, paper trading, or real money. Obtain a Mexican legal opinion before any real-money use.
rows.benefit: Removes legal risk before any money moves.
options: A: Research and paper trading only (no real money)
B: Real money after legal opinion
rows.source: S05, S06 (Mexico law); S08, S10 (NFL policy)
